programme.title: #IkLome / #LIKEME
programme.desc: The emotions rise high during a school trip. After another collision, an angry caro gives everyone a wipe. She is more than fed up with the fight. Ze is de ruzie meer dan beu. Was haar terugkeer naar Antwerpen dan echt een slechte beslissing?

programme.title: Break / Kapot Gaan
programme.desc: Gloria breaks down the speed with Ayana and Jonathan. As a warm-up they try to be flashed in a zone 30 street, then they go cycling in a real indoor bike rack and eventually try to break all speed records while karting. / Gloria gaat kapot van de snelheid met Ayana en Jonathan. Als opwarmertje proberen ze al lopend geflitst te worden in een zone 30-straat, daarna gaan ze fietsen in een echte indoorfietspiste en uiteindelijk proberen ze tijdens het karten alle snelheidsrecords te verbreken.

programme.title: De Board of Soekie / De Raad van Soekie
programme.desc: Pedro sets up a classroom as a VIP space that is only accessible to rich students. But Pedro quickly expands the privileges for the rich. For example, only they can take lessons in the classrooms. The poor students have to follow the lessons outside in front of the window. Soekie leads the opposition to this inequality. / Pedro richt een klaslokaal in als een vipruimte die enkel toegankelijk is voor rijke leerlingen. Maar Pedro breidt de privileges voor de rijken snel uit. Zo mogen enkel zij nog les volgen in de klaslokalen. De arme leerlingen moeten de lessen buiten voor het raam volgen. Soekie leidt het verzet tegen deze ongelijkheid.

programme.title: Stip it: the pest glasses / Stip it: de pestbril

En ook Jacotte Brokken kan er helaas van meepraten.

programme.desc: Amber asked Kristel and Fatih - after her forced admission - to continue the help. programme.desc: Travel, try, love with Lazar, will discover you the charms of tourism and gastronomy throughout the Republika Srpska and take you to the famous, less famous and even completely unknown places. The author of the show, actor and cook Lazar Petrović, will show you what their nature looks like, people, and what is traditions, both in gastronomy, including customs and lifestyle. / Putuj, probaj, zavoli sa Lazarom otkriće vam čari turizma i gastronomije širom Republike Srpske i odvešće vas na poznata, manje poznata, pa čak i sasvim nepoznata mjesta. Autor emisije, glumac i kuvar Lazar Petrović, pokazaće vam kako izgleda njihova priroda, ljudi, te šta je u tim krajevima tradicija, kako u gastronomiji, pa tako i običajima i načinu života.

programme.desc: The series follows the life behind and in front of the camera of your favorite TV steam, Roe deer and Mark. programme.title: A nation witness / Narod priča
programme.desc: The new format, the author's travel-recorted journalist Biljana Stokic, discovery what the heart of the people tells about the Serbian, the tradition and history of our cities and villages, their everyday life and the struggle for preserving true values, diligent work, faith, and love for theirs and ours, Otamb. In a combination of sincere stories of those who live on their work, through the discovery of the sights and natural beauties of our country and their homes, with the words of hope and inspiration, and with pictures of which the heart is melted, with a cheerfulness that defeats all obstacles and problems, Biljana Stokic will peek into their everyday life. How does an ordinary man live? What are his problems and challenges? What is the strength to work and nurture tradition and good interpersonal relationships? How does our native lump breathe and does she have a flat in her beauty? What do they remember? What are they stunned before? What are they coming back? In front of our camera, they will open up and tell the story, who we do not know how much they carry love, research, courage in themselves, those who know how strangely difficult and easy life is, those who have felt the suffering and beauty of life's simplicity. / Novi format, autorska putopisno-reportažna emisija novinarke Biljane Stokić, otkriće vam šta srce naroda priča o Srpskoj, o tradiciji i istoriji naših gradova i sela, o njihovoj svakodnevici i borbi za očuvanje pravih vrijednosti, marljivom radu, vjeri, i ljubavi prema njihovoj i našoj, otadžbini. U spletu iskrenih priča onih koji žive od svog rada, kroz otkrivanje znamenitosti i prirodnih ljepota naše zemlje i njihovih domova, uz riječi nade i inspiracije, te uz slike od kojih se rastopi srce, sa vedrinom koja porazi sve prepreke i probleme, Biljana Stokić će, dugogodišnjim novinarskim iskustvom, zaviriti u njihovu svakodnevicu. Kako živi običan čovjek? Koji su njegovi problemi i izazovi? U čemu nalazi snagu za radom i njegovanje tradicije i dobrih međuljudskih odnosa? Kako diše naša rodna gruda i ima li joj u ljepoti ravne? Čega se sjećaju? Pred čim ostaju zadivljeni? Čemu se vraćaju? Pred našom kamerom, otvoriće se i ispričati priču, oni za koje ne znamo koliko u sebi nose ljubavi, istrajnosti, hrabrosti, oni koji znaju koliko je život čudnovato težak i lak, oni koji su osjetili i stradanje i ljepotu životne jednostavnosti.

Dječakov veliki san je poći očevim stopama i postati vrhunski duelist. Nakon što nenadano otkrije novu tehniku za prizivanje čudovišta, taj san polako počinje biti njegova stvarnost.

programme.title: Slugterra / Slugterra
programme.desc: Fifteen -year -old Eli Shane is in life all usually, except one thing. Comes from the Shane family. Each member of that family traveled to the Underground of Slugterre to protect the special world of Slugs. Now it is a turn on the Elijah, to visit the underground and to protect it from the enemy, whether he is ready or not. Eli is persistent in the intention of becoming a hero, in order to manage to resist the forces of evil. Together with trixie friends, cords and prontine, he must carefully collect and train small animals, different snails, who have the ability to transform into magical monsters. / Petnaestogodišnjem Eliju Shaneu je u životu sve obično, osim jedne stvari. Dolazi iz porodice Shane. Svaki član te porodice putovao je u podzemlje Slugterre, kako bi zaštitio posebni svijet slug-ova. Sada je red na Elija, da posjeti podzemlje i da ga zaštiti od neprijatelja, bio on spreman ili ne. Eli je ustrajan u namjeri da postane heroj, kako bi se uspio oduprijeti silama zla. Zajedno sa prijateljima Trixie, Kordom i Prontom mora pažljivo sakupljati i trenirati male životinje, različite puževe, koji imaju sposobnost transformirati se u magična čudovišta.

programme.title: Football: League 1 in France: 4 round: Monaco - Metz / Футбол: Лига 1 на Франция: 4 кръг: Монако - Мец
programme.desc: League 1 consists of 20 teams that compete against each other in 38 rounds, changed. The French Championship dates from 1892, the so -called Amateur League until 1929. In 1932, the foundations of professionally organized football in France were laid. The French Division 1 includes in its first season 1932-33 the following teams, divided into two groups: Club France, Excelsior, Ier, Lille, Marseille, Muluz, Nice, Nim, Racing Paris, Ale, Antib, Khan, are Paris, Fiv, Montz, Red Star, Ren and Sosho. In recent years, much later, the formed club Paris Saint-Germain has been an absolute dominant on the home stage, but before that, Lyon, Marseille, Bordeaux, Monaco, Nan, Saint Etienne, Reim, Nice, Lance and more have also had many successes. / Лига 1 се състои от 20 отбора, които се състезават един срещу друг в 38 кръга, на разменено гостуване. Френският шампионат датира от 1892, така нареченета Аматьорска лига до 1929. През 1932 се полагат основите на професионално организраният футбол във Франция. Френската Дивизия 1 включва в своя първи сезон 1932-33 следните отбори, разделени в две групи: Клуб Франсе, Екселсиор, Иер, Лил, Марсилия, Мюлуз, Ница, Ним, Расинг Париж, Сет, Але, Антиб, Кан, СА Париж, Фив, Метц, Монпелие, Ред Стар, Рен и Сошо. През последните години доста по-късно сформирания клуб Пари Сен Жермен е абсолютен доминатор на домашната сцена, но преди това много успехи са имали също Лион, Марсилия, Бордо, Монако, Нан, Сен Етиен, Рейм, Ница, Ланс и др.

Френската Дивизия 1 включва в своя първи сезон 1932-33 следните отбори, разделени в две групи: Клуб Франсе, Екселсиор, Иер, Лил, Марсилия, Мюлуз, Ница, Ним, Расинг Париж, Сет, Але, Антиб, Кан, СА Париж, Фив, Метц, Монпелие, Ред Стар, Рен и Сошо. През последните години доста по-късно сформирания клуб Пари Сен Жермен е абсолютен доминатор на домашната сцена, но преди това много успехи са имали също Лион, Марсилия, Бордо, Монако, Нан, Сен Етиен, Рейм, Ница, Ланс и др.

programme.title: The promise / La Promesa
programme.desc: La Proses - (S04, E29, feature series, Spain, 2024) In 1913, while Europe is ruled by unrest, life on the noble estate of LA Provece owned by the Luján family cannot be more peaceful - at least it seems. The family is preparing to celebrate one of the most important events in Spanish surplus society - the wedding of Tomás, the eldest son of Count Luján and the daughter of one of the most comfortable families in the country. However, the Luján family knows that this is a contracted marriage that the family should save from financial ruin. In the meantime, the enigmatic young Jana (20) begins to work on LA Promethew and helps as a maid during preparation for a wedding. As he wanders the building, he meets Manuel (23) the Counts of the youngest son and Tomás's half -brother. It is a meeting that will not be able to forget ... The Countess on the day of the wedding cannot hide her dissatisfaction since she wanted the groom to actually be her son Manuel. Her dissatisfaction is growing increasing, and after her outburst of anger, Jana gets fired. During the wedding, everything goes according to plan until Manuel performs a play with his plane double and shows incredible acrobatic skills, and the celebration is interrupted when he loses control and collapses not far from the property. Jana saw what happened and hurried to the scene to save Manuel. The Count offered Jani a generous award in gratitude, but she only asked to return her to work. The family does not know this, but Jana has a plan to avenge her mother who happened 15 years ago and wants to find her younger brother, who has been abducted the same evening. The only trail that Jana has to lead is to the magnificent building of La Provece, which he wants to infiltrate and find a murderer ... but also find love in Manuel's embrace. The next day another unfortunate event brings confusion to the property. Tomás was found dead. Sergeant Conrado, a member of the Civil Guard, is determined in his plan to find the killer. All evidence is referred to Jan because she is the last person with whom Tomás talked before his death. R .: Miguel Conda ... / La promesa - (S04, E29, igrana serija, Španjolska, 2024) Godine 1913., dok Europom vladaju nemiri, život na plemićkom imanju La Promesa u vlasništvu obitelji Luján ne može biti mirniji - bar se tako čini. Obitelj se priprema za proslavu jednog od najvažnijih događaja u španjolskom viskom društvu - vjenčanje Tomása, najstarijeg sina grofa Lujána i kćeri jedne od najimućnijih obitelji u zemlji. Međutim, obitelj Luján zna kako je ovo ugovoreni brak koji bi obitelj trebao spasiti od financijske propasti. U međuvremenu, zagonetna mlada Jana (20) počinje raditi na La Promesi te kao sluškinja pomaže tijekom priprema za vjenčanje. Dok luta zdanjem, susreće Manuela (23) grofova najmlađeg sina i Tomásova polubrata. Susret je to koji neće moći zaboraviti... Grofica na dan vjenčanja ne može skriti svoje nezadovoljstvo budući da je ona htjela da mladoženja zapravo bude njezin sin Manuel. Njezino nezadovoljstvo sve više raste, a nakon njezina ispada bijesa, Jana dobiva otkaz. Tijekom vjenčanja sve ide po planu sve dok Manuel ne izvede predstavu sa svojim avionom dvokrilcem te pokaže nevjerojatne akrobatske vještine, a slavlje se prekida kad izgubi kontrolu i sruši se nedaleko od imanja. Jana je vidjela što se dogodilo te pohita na mjesto nesreće kako bi spasila Manuela. Grof ponudi Jani velikodušnu nagradu u znak zahvalnosti, ali ona zatraži samo da je vrate na posao. Obitelj to ne zna, ali Jana cijelo vrijeme ima plan osvetiti ubojstvo svoje majke koje se dogodilo prije 15 godina te želi pronaći svog mlađeg brata koji je iste večeri otet. Jedini trag koji Jana ima vodi je do velebnog zdanja La Promesa u koje se želi infiltrirati te pronaći ubojicu... Ali i naći ljubav u Manuelovom zagrljaju. Idućeg dana još jedan nesretni događaj unese pomutnju na imanje. Tomás je pronađen mrtav. Narednik Conrado, pripadnik civilne garde, odlučan je u svom naumu da pronađe ubojicu. Svi dokazi upućuju na Janu jer ona je posljednja osoba s kojom je Tomás prije smrti razgovarao. R.: Miguel Cond...

Series, England, 2024) Kevin McCloud, Head and author of the series, goes on a nostalgic journey to the beginning of the marvelous design world, to visit the first home builders in New Hoven in 1999. Tim and Jules, the owners of the Dragons and Parachute Flying School, have four daughters from his and her previous marriage and a fifth, a common child on the way. Therefore, they decide to build a spacious family home on the cliffs of East Sussex in a record three months. However, digging the foundation as well as raising the assembly house did not go as planned, the prices of the material rose rapidly and almost failed to complete the house. A child who was to be born in a new house was born in an old, surrounded family. Kevin McCloud comes to visit them a quarter of a century later, surprised that Tim and Jules and now the adult son Tiger are still in that newly built house where they have changed nothing and enjoyed as on the first day. R .: Ned Williams ... / Grand Designs - (S22, E06, dok. serija, Engleska, 2024) Kevin McCloud, voditelj i autor serije, odlazi na nostalgično putovanje na sam početak Čudesnog svijeta dizajna, u posjet prvim graditeljima kuće u Newhavenu davne 1999. godine. Tim i Jules, vlasnici škole zmajarenja i padobranskog letenja, imaju četiri kćeri iz njegova i njezina prethodnog braka te peto, zajedničko dijete na putu. programme.title: I mean, I dig, I did / Mislim, kopam, jesam
programme.desc: I mean, I dig, I did - (Doc. Film, Croatia, 2008) there is almost no man who at least once did not say "I have a lot of town, car noise and pollution, I would like to live in nature", but rarely they have ventured into the act. This is a documentary about them. The first story introduces us to the married couple Kis, intellectuals who left their jobs in Zagreb and located under Motovun in Istria. Strong individuals, live and cultivate their garden modeled on a large Fukuok teacher from Japan, the originator of the idea of ​​permaculture - organic growing of vegetables without pesticides. The second story was shot in Japan, in Mrs. Matsuo's garden, also followers of Fukuoka and Kamaguchi students. For many years, Mrs. Matsuo has been decorating her organic garden where everything lives in harmony - humans, earth, plants and animals. Its motto is that it is important to do something good in life for other people, so she teaches her students the knowledge and philosophy of life about a non -violence in nature. The third story is a marital couple with a small child living on Učka. When Armano Jericevic left the interest of the dentist in Zagreb and bought an abandoned house on Učka, he had no idea that after ten years of wandering around the world, literally and spiritually, Učka and abandoned village would become a home. And he cultivates his garden modeled on fukuok. The subtle reflection of life and life in accordance with nature, here and today, is his philosophy of life. R .: Ljubica Jankovic Lazaric ... / Mislim, kopam, jesam - (dok. film, Hrvatska, 2008) Gotovo da nema čovjeka koji bar jednom nije rekao "dosta mi je grada, buke automobila i zagađenja, želio bih živjeti u prirodi", ali rijetki su se i odvažili na taj čin. Ovo je dokumentarni film o njima. Prva priča nas upoznaje s bračnim parom Kiš, intelektualcima koji su napustili svoja radna mjesta u Zagrebu i smjestili se ispod Motovuna u Istri. Jaki individualci, žive i obrađuju svoj vrt po uzoru na velikog učitelja Fukuoku iz Japana, začetnika ideje o permakulturi - organskom uzgoju povrća bez pesticida. Druga je priča snimljena u Japanu, u vrtu gospođe Matsuo, također sljedbenice Fukuoke i učenice Kamaguchija. Dugi niz godina gospođa Matsuo uređuje svoj organski vrt u kojem sve živi u harmoniji - ljudi, zemlja, biljke i životinje. Njezin je moto da je u životu važno učiniti nešto dobro i za druge ljude, pa svojim učenicima predaje znanje i filozofiju života o nenasilju u prirodi. Treća je priča o bračnom paru s malim djetetetom koji žive na Učki. Kada je Armano Jeričević napuštao zanimanje stomatologa u Zagrebu i kupio napuštenu kuću na Učki, nije ni slutio da će mu nakon deset godina lutanja po svijetu, doslovno i duhovno, Učka i napušteno selo postati dom. I on svoj vrt obrađuje po uzoru na Fukuoku. Suptilno promišljanje života i život u skladu s prirodom, ovdje i danas, njegova je filozofija života. R.: Ljubica Janković Lazarić...

programme.title: Ribar fish bite the tail / Ribar ribi grize rep
programme.desc: Fisherman's fish bite the tail - (E04, Doc. Series, Croatia, 2009) "The Fourth Day of" Fisherman's Fisherman Bite the Tail "you will see Zagreb and Slavonac take the Palamida of 5 kilos in the middle of the Gulf of Malošinj, and they will also reveal to you why the successful Palamidols must use fluorocarbonic leads. We will see Simunovićs from Dubrovnik who throw their networks under the walls, and the special specialty of the episode is the encounter with the most awarded Croatian sports fisherman of all time, Josko Radman from the Soltan Maslinica. If you look at the last part of the series, you will meet with "Higher Mathematics of Fishing", and find out what the sea temperature should be, the time and the moon's change, to get home with big fish. In the end, we will prepare a recently caught Palamide according to a rare recipe for the famous Lošinj restaurant. In addition to being a kind of fishing school, both for the beginner and for the experienced ones who will learn some new trick from the best, the "Fisherman's Fisherman's Fish Bites the Tail" series is also a movie for lovers of untouched nature and original marine atmosphere. Recorded with several cameras, including an underwater hidden camera, the "Fisherman's Fisherman bite the tail" series gives a contemporary insight into the primordial outburst between man and fish. R .: Hrvoje Juvančić ... / Ribar ribi grize rep - (E04, dok. serija, Hrvatska, 2009) "Četvrtog dana" serijala "Ribar ribi grize rep" vidjet ćete kako Zagrepčanin i Slavonac vade palamide od 5 kila usred malološinjskog zaljeva, a oni će vam otkriti i zašto se za uspješan palamidolov moraju koristiti fluorokarbonski predvezi. Vidjet ćemo Šimunoviće iz Dubrovnika koji bacaju svoje mreže takoreći ispod zidina, a poseban specijalitet epizode je susret s najnagrađivanijim hrvatskim sportskim ribolovcem svih vremena, Joškom Radmanom iz šoltanske Maslinice. Pogledate li zadnji dio serijala, susrest ćete se s "višom matematikom ribolova", i saznati kakve trebaju biti temperatura mora, vrijeme i Mjesečeva mijena, da bi se kući vratili s velikom ribom. Na kraju ćemo pripremiti netom ulovljenu palamidu prema rijetkom receptu poznatog lošinjskog restorana. Osim što je svojevrsna škola ribolova, kako za početnika, tako i za one iskusne koji će naučiti poneki novi trik od najboljih, serija "Ribar ribi grize rep" ujedno je i film za ljubitelje netaknute prirode i izvornog morskog ugođaja. Snimana s nekoliko kamera, među kojima i podvodnom skrivenom kamerom, serija "Ribar ribi grize rep" daje suvremeni uvid u iskonsko nadmudrivanje između čovjeka i ribe. R.: Hrvoje Juvančić...

After that, we bring a conversation with him just before going out to the podium, with thoughts about first appearances, growing up with a violin in his hand, moving to maturity, exploring ourselves, but also searching for inspiration in parachute or electric monocyle ride. His concert is also accompanied by his colleague, violinist Laura Vadjon ... / Svijet klasike - (glazb. emisija, Hrvatska, 2024) Emisija kreće malim šestogodišnjim Stefanom Milenkovićem koji sa Zagrebačkim solistima svira Vivaldijeva "Četiri godišnja doba". Nakon toga donosimo razgovor s njime snimljen netom pred izlazak na podij, uz razmišljanja o prvim nastupima, odrastanjem s violinom u ruci, prelasku u zrelost, istraživanju sebe, ali i traganjima za inspiracijom u padobranstvu ili vožnji električnog monocikla. programme.title: The world of jazz / Svijet jazza
programme.desc: Jazza World - (Music. A show, Croatia, 2025) The merger of fine arts, jazz and improvisation has a decade tradition, and it has especially come to life in avant -garde New York in the 60s, when radical research occurs in all fields of art. Today, it does not have to be primarily related to this type of radicality, but also takes on other, more intimate forms. The last one is certainly the Obrovac², a multimedia dedication to musician Tamara Obrovac to the late father, painter, graphic artist and sculptor Ivan. It is a dialogue between the fragments of Obrovc's paintings, for the projections of which is the artist Ivan Marusic Klif, and the musical improvisation of the transhistria Quartet, also made up of Uros Rakovec on guitar, mandolini and Citri, Ziga Golob on Counterbasle and Krunoslav Levacic on drums. In this sense, the dedication that Obrovac sounds sounds sound with his great musicians, the masters of dialogue, becomes the only thing that the artist's dedication to the artist may be: not a frozen memories, but every time the renewed creation. In this closing of the circle between the avant-garde in the 60s and the Mediterranean ethnoses that abounds her work, one of the signs of Tamara Obrovac and her composition, which we could witness at the end of March at the Zagreb cinema ... / Svijet jazza - (glazb. emisija, Hrvatska, 2025) Spajanje likovne umjetnosti, jazza i improvizacije ima desetljetnu tradiciju, a posebno je zaživjelo u avangardnom New Yorku 60-ih, kada se u svim područjima umjetnosti događaju radikalna istraživanja. Danas ono ne mora biti primarno vezano za takvu vrstu radikalnosti, nego poprima i druge, intimnije oblike. Među posljednje svakako se ubraja Obrovac², multimedijska posveta glazbenice Tamare Obrovac pokojnom ocu, slikaru, grafičaru i kiparu Ivanu. Riječ je o dijalogu između fragmenata Obrovčevih slika, za čije je projekcije zadužen umjetnik Ivan Marušić Klif, i glazbenih improvizacija Transhistria Quarteta, koji čine još i Uroš Rakovec na gitari, mandolini i citri, Žiga Golob na kontrabasu i Krunoslav Levačić na bubnjevima. U tom smislu posveta koju Obrovac zvučno ispisuje sa svojim sjajnim glazbenicima, majstorima dijaloga, postaje jedino što posveta umjetnika, odnosno umjetnice umjetniku može biti: ne zaleđena uspomena, nego svaki put obnovljeno stvaranje. U tom zatvaranju kruga između avangarde 60-ih i mediteranskih etnoslojeva kojima obiluje njezin rad, vidi se još jedan od znakova veličine Tamare Obrovac i njezina sastava, kojoj smo nanovo mogli svjedočiti potkraj ožujka u zagrebačkoj Kinoteci...

programme.title: Jerôme: A look into the blue / Jerôme: Pogled u plavetnilo
programme.desc: Jerôme, Les Yeux Dans Le Bleu - (E02, Doc. Film, France, 2021) in Mexico Jerôme Delafosse begins his adventure on Banc Chinchorr, the deepest and most beautiful coral reef of South America. He spends a normal day with Matrac and his community of traditional fishermen who lead harmonious coexistence with crocodiles. Then he goes to the Yucatan Peninsula, where he is with Tristan and David, two speleologists' divers, and explore the cenote. Cenotes are exceptional geological underground formations that supply the entire area with drinking water, and Mayans consider them entrance to the underground world of spirits. The journey is completed at Caba Pulma, on the western coast of Mexico, where he meets Mary, a former fisherman who has turned the area into one of the largest sea refuge on the continent. Jerôme with him darkens among thousands and thousands of marine dogs. Diving realizes how much a person can help successfully protect the biodiversity of the underwater. R .: Jerôme Delafosse ... / Jerôme, les yeux dans le bleu - (E02, dok. film, Francuska, 2021) U Meksiku Jerôme Delafosse svoju pustolovinu počinje na Bancu Chinchorru, najduljem i najljepšem koraljnom grebenu Južne Amerike. Provodi uobičajen dan s Matracom i njegovom zajednicom tradicionalnih ribara koji vode skladan suživot s krokodilima. Zatim odlazi na poluotok Yucatan gdje se nalazi s Tristanom i Davidom, dvojicom ronilaca speleologa, i zajedno istražuju cenote. Cenote su iznimne geološke podzemne formacije koje cijelo područje opskrbljuju pitkom vodom, a Maje ih smatraju ulazom u podzemni svijet duhova. Putovanje dovršava u Cabu Pulmu, na zapadnoj obali Meksika, gdje susreće Marija, bivšeg ribara koji je to područje pretvorio u jedno od najvećih morskih utočišta na kontinentu. Jerôme s njime zaranja među tisuće i tisuće morskih pasa glavonja. Roneći shvaća koliko čovjek može pomoći da se uspješno zaštiti biološka raznolikost podmorja. R.: Jerôme Delafosse...

programme.title: Forests and people / Šume i ljudi
programme.desc: Forests and humans - (E01, Doc. Film, Croatia, 2002) The show starts from the wooden architecture of Posavina, the gorge of pigs, and through today's intersection of oaks, it would come to the foundation of the Đakovo Cathedral made up of 370 oak carcasses, vertically stuck in a soft swampy soil. There is talk of the construction of this cathedral, the establishment of the Academy of Sciences and Arts, the reconstruction of the University of Zagreb and their financing with oak money from the Episcopal estate from Đakovo. It is a crunch of lowland forests for agriculture, the settlement of Slavonia and the beginnings of the wood industry in the early 20th century. Mature oaks are hungry, centuries -old plants. When Jupiter and Saturn were young, they approached the sun. Jupiter caused chaos among small planets, and then with Saturn's help moved away from the sun and took the current position. R .: Patrick Volve Ul.: Beatrice Mujdei (Little Malabar) ... / Petit Malabar - (S02, E06, crt. serija, Engleska, 2022) Mali Malabar i kornjačica plivat će okruženi ribama, a onda će doplivati velika kornjača i unijeti kaos! Na to će se Sunce nasmijati i reći da je Jupiter na sličan način unio kaos među planete u Sunčevu sustavu u davnoj prošlosti kad su još bili mladi. Kad su Jupiter i Saturn bili mladi, približili su se Suncu. Jupiter je uzrokovao kaos među malim planetima, a potom se uz Saturnovu pomoć odmaknuo od Sunca i zauzeo trenutačni položaj. R.: Patrick Volve Ul.: Beatrice Mujdei (Mali Malabar)...

programme.title: Pepa Praščić / Pepa Praščić
programme.desc: Pappa Pig - (S02, E15, feature series, England) "Pesto Peppa" is a British animated TV series for preschool children. The main character of the series is Peppa, a women's pig with many human traits, and there are her family and friends. This long -standing series for children is accompanied by the events and accidents of Peppe and her friends, her brother George, their parents and other animal families living in their city. Each family represents another animal species, so Pappin's friends are bunny Rebecca, sheep Suzy and Candy Cat. In every episode of a cheerful company, he experiences new adventures, and the shop often helps children deal with new feelings and experiences that brings with them growing up. The main character of the series is Peppa, a female pig with a lot of human traits. With her, there are also her family and friends. Peppa's friends are her age, while her younger brother's friends are his peers. The plot of the episode are related to daily activities of children - going to kindergarten, swimming, visit to grandparents or other relatives, playground games or cycling. The characters in the series wear clothes, live in homes and drive cars, but also show some characteristics of those animals on which they are based. R .: Mark Baker Ul.: John Sparkes (narrator) ... / Peppa Pig - (S02, E15, igrana serija, Engleska) "Praščić Peppa" je britanska animirana TV serija namijenjena djeci predškolskog uzrasta. Glavni lik serije je Peppa, žensko prase s mnogo ljudskih osobina, a tu su još i njezina obitelj i prijatelji. Ova dugovječna serija za djecu prati zgode i nezgode Peppe i njezinih prijatelja, njezinog brata Georgea, njihovih roditelja i drugih životinjskih obitelji koje žive u njihovom gradu. Svaka obitelj predstavlja drugu životinjsku vrstu pa su tako Peppini prijatelji zečica Rebecca, ovca Suzy i mačka Candy. U svakoj epizodi vesela družina doživljava nove avanture, a radnja često pomaže djeci da se nose s novim osjećajima i iskustvima koje sa sobom donosi odrastanje. Glavni lik serije je Peppa, žensko prase s puno ljudskih osobina. Uz nju, tu su još njezina obitelj i prijatelji. Peppini prijatelji su njezinih godina, dok su prijatelji njezinog mlađeg brata njegovi vršnjaci. Zapleti epizoda vezani su uz svakodnevne aktivnosti djece - odlaske u vrtić, plivanja, posjete djedu i baki ili drugim rođacima, igre na igralištu ili vožnje biciklima. Likovi u seriji nose odjeću, žive u kućama i voze automobile, no pokazuju i neke osobine onih životinja na kojima su temeljeni. R.: Mark Baker Ul.: John Sparkes (Narator)...

programme.title: Studio 4: Diagnosis / Studio 4: Dijagnoza
programme.desc: Studio 4: Diagnosis - (Show Magazine, Croatia, 2025) The theme of this week's show is the strategic independence of the European Union in the production of drugs and solving drug shortages. In light of the increasingly frequent shortcomings and impairment of the safety of supply chains, a new law on critical drugs is being prepared. The European Parliament, the Council and the Commission soon begin inter -institutional negotiations on the reform of EU pharmaceutical legislation, which makes this topic extremely current for all EU citizens. We will pay special attention to what we can expect and what are the specifics for our state. The guests on the show are Doc. Ph.D. Irena Hrstic, MD, Minister of Health of the Republic of Croatia, and Asst. Ph.D. Tomislav Sokol, MP in the European Parliament ... / Studio 4: Dijagnoza - (show magazin, Hrvatska, 2025) Tema ovotjedne emisije je strateška neovisnost Europske unije u proizvodnji lijekova i rješavanje problema nestašice lijekova. U svjetlu sve češćih nestašica i narušavanja sigurnosti opskrbnih lanaca, priprema se novi zakon o kritičnim lijekovima. Europski parlament, Vijeće i Komisija uskoro započinju međuinstitucijske pregovore o reformi EU farmaceutskog zakonodavstva, što ovu temu čini iznimno aktualnom za sve građane EU. Posebnu pozornost posvetit ćemo onome što možemo očekivati i koje su specifičnosti za našu državu. Gosti u emisiji su doc. dr. sc. Irena Hrstić, dr. med., ministrica zdravstva RH, i doc. dr. sc. Tomislav Sokol, zastupnik u Europskom parlamentu...

programme.title: Smallerness / Menšíkoviny
programme.desc: What Václav Postránecký experienced in the company of a great actor, an excellent entertainer and wise man Vladimír Menšík ... Excellent actor Vladimír Menšík can be commemorated not only by watching his films and listening to his unforgettable narratives, but also through humorous events that his colleagues experienced with him. Like actor Václav Postránecký, who with Vladimír Menšík stood many times in front of a film or television camera and collected a lot of cheerful stories over the years. And they will share these stories with us and the audience in the TV studio in the entertainment program called Menšíkovina, which was filmed in 1999. / Co všechno zažil Václav Postránecký ve společnosti skvěleho herce, vynikajícího baviče a moudreho člověka Vladimíra Menšíka... Vynikajícího herce Vladimíra Menšíka si můžeme připomínat nejen sledováním jeho filmů a poslechem audionahrávek jeho nezapomenutelných vyprávění, ale i prostřednictvím humorných příhod, ktere s ním zažili jeho kolegove. Jako třeba herec Václav Postránecký, který s Vladimírem Menšíkem mnohokrát stál před filmovou či televizní kamerou a nasbíral tak o něm za ta leta spoustu veselých historek. A o tyto historky se s námi i s publikem v televizním studiu podělí v zábavním pořadu nazvanem Menšíkoviny, který byl natočen v roce 1999.

programme.title: Rajske garden / Rajske zahrady
programme.desc: Large garden on the Male side! Even this pun can be characterized by the Wallenstein Garden, monumental as its dimension - for the palace gardens had to settle for a much more cramped space - at the same time the mannerist concept that breathed its playful and fantasy character. Where else in the Czech Republic there is a garden vegetation with beautiful statues (the author of the original sculptures is the famous Adriaen de Vries), with refined water elements with a gigantic artificial stalactite wall, which is visible from the windows of Prague Castle. Albrecht of Wallenstein set up this garden as a mirror of his glory and power. He focused on building it (as well as building the adjacent palace) of a significantly artistic personality of his time and despite all the changes that the garden has undergone in the following centuries, we can still admire the sophisticated aesthetics of this space today. And the puns and the vagaries that the garden hides, only the water on the mill of the fantasy of Arnošt Goldflam and Josef Polášek, whose unconventional approach ... / Velká zahrada na Male Straně! I touto hříčkou lze charakterizovat Valdštejnskou zahradu, monumentální jak svým rozměrem – vždyť běžne palácove zahrady se musely spokojit s daleko stísněnějším prostorem – zároveň i manýristickým konceptem, který vdechl tomuto zákoutí svůj hravý a fantazijní charakter. Kde jinde v ČR se potkává zahradní rostlinstvo s nádhernými sochami (autorem původních plastik je slavný Adriaen de Vries), s rafinovanými vodními prvky i s gigantickou umělou krápníkovou stěnou, která je viditelná až z oken Pražskeho hradu. Albrecht z Valdštejna založil tuto zahradu jako zrcadlo sve slávy a moci. Soustředil k jejímu budování (jakož i k budování přilehleho paláce) výrazne umělecke osobnosti sve doby a přes veškere proměny, kterými zahrada v následujících stoletích prošla, můžeme i dnes obdivovat důmyslnou estetiku tohoto prostoru. A hříčky a rozmary, ktere zahrada ukrývá, jen ženou vodu na mlýn fantazie Arnošta Goldflama a Josefa Poláška, jejichž netradiční přístup...

programme.desc: How can you talk about peace when wars are normality? Under the title "Never Again Peace", the 58th edition of the "Styrian Autumn" festival is devoted to an issue that could not be more current. Ernst Toller's anti -fascist satire "Never again peace", which was created in 1936, forms the starting point for numerous artistic projects on the past and today's conflicts. Dimitre calls Dinev "time of the brave", who fled from Bulgaria to Austria in 1990 is his opus magnum. It is a very personal billing with its former homeland, in which he traces the leading atmosphere in the former communist-fascist country and explores the history of Europe. Abuse of power, leaked chats, corruption scandals on theater stages? While the media landscape has been fighting for the trust of its readership for years, daily and social policy gradually conquers the boards that mean the world. Investigative ... / Wie kann man uber Frieden reden, wenn Kriege Normalitat sind? Unter dem Titel "Never Again Peace" widmet sich die 58. Ausgabe des "steirischen herbst"-Festivals einem Thema, das aktueller nicht sein konnte. Ernst Tollers antifaschistische Satire "Nie wieder Friede", die 1936 entstanden ist bildet dabei den Ausgangspunkt fur zahlreiche kunstlerische Projekte zu den vergangenen wie heutigen Konflikten. "Zeit der Mutigen" nennt Dimitre Dinev, der 1990 aus Bulgarien nach Österreich geflohen ist sein Opus Magnum. Es ist eine sehr personliche Abrechnung mit seiner einstigen Heimat, in der er die bleierne Atmosphare in dem einstig kommunistisch-faschistischen Land nachzeichnet und dabei die Geschichte Europas erkundet. Machtmissbrauch, geleakte Chats, Korruptionsskandale auf Theaterbuhnen? Wahrend die Medienlandschaft seit Jahren um das Vertrauen ihrer Leserschaft kampft, erobert Tages- wie Gesellschaftspolitik sukzessive die Bretter, die die Welt bedeuten. Investigative...

programme.title: Meryn's consulting room / Meryns Sprechzimmer
programme.desc: In our society, often only the smiling mask of perfection - but behind some faces there are heavy loads. In Meryn's consulting room, we are talking openly about the most urgent topics of our time: bullying, eating, depression, fears and even suicidality. But it is not just about creation, it's also about encouraging and practical tips: exercises, routines and impulses that can help in everyday life - whether with children, young people or adults. In Meryns Sprechzimmer reden wir offen uber die drangendsten Themen unserer Zeit: Mobbing, Essstorungen, Depressionen, Ängste und sogar Suizidalitat. Unsere Gaste, Expertinnen, Betroffene und Angehorige, teilen ihre Erfahrungen und geben Einblicke in die vielfaltigen Herausforderungen, denen Menschen jeden Alters begegnen. Doch es geht nicht nur um Aufklarung, es geht auch ums Mut machen und praktische Tipps: Übungen, Routinen und Impulse, die im Alltag helfen konnen - egal ob bei Kindern, Jugendlichen oder Erwachsenen. programme.title: Die Protein-Luge / Die Protein-Luge
programme.desc: No matter whether yogurt, pizza or energy drink - food with many proteins are trendy. Packed black and often pretended by fitness influencers, they are advertised as part of a healthy lifestyle. The products are particularly well received by the body -conscious young generation. Many promise to lose weight or even build muscle without sport. A billion-dollar wing for industry, because extra protein brings extra margin. Extra rip-off, say consumer protection. Because added protein, such as whey protein, is not only highly processed, but also a by -product from the gas production. A residual protein that is sold expensive as a healthy additive. Carnty scientists and doctors also warn of too much protein. Because energy that the body does not need is stored as fat. The medical journalist Bernhard Hain shows what proteins can and what not. / Egal ob Joghurt, Pizza oder Energy-Drink - Lebensmittel mit vielen Proteinen liegen im Trend. Schwarz verpackt und oft von Fitness-Influencern prasentiert, werden sie als Teil eines gesunden Lebensstils beworben. Besonders bei der korperbewussten jungen Generation kommen die Produkte gut an. Viele versprechen sich davon abzunehmen oder gar Muskeln ohne Sport aufzubauen. Ein Milliarden-Geschaft fur die Industrie, denn Extra-Protein bringt Extra-Marge. Extra-Abzocke, sagen Konsumentenschutzer. Denn zugesetztes Protein, wie etwa MolkeneiweiSS, ist nicht nur hochverarbeitet, sondern auch ein Nebenprodukt aus der Kaseherstellung. Ein ResteiweiSS, das als gesunder Zusatzstoff teuer verkauft wird. Auch Ernahrungswissenschaftler und Mediziner warnen vor einem Zuviel an EiweiSS. Denn Energie, die der Korper nicht braucht, lagert er als Fett ein. Der Medizinjournalist Bernhard Hain zeigt, was Proteine konnen und was nicht.

programme.desc: S01E02 Nelson Muller gets to the bottom of a detachment legend: an egg every day - that's good for health. What about this advice? Das belastet jedoch zunehmend die Umwelt. Neuartige Fischzuchten sollen die Losung sein. Die findet Nelson Muller aber nicht etwa an der Nordsee, sondern in den Alpen. Wie moderne Fischzucht in der Zukunft aussehen konnte und ob sie wirklich nachhaltiger ist, zeigt der Sternekoch in der Schweiz. Die Alternative zu Fleisch, Fisch und Milch sind pflanzliche Proteine. Vor allem Soja gilt als besonders proteinreich - nicht umsonst besteht Fleischersatz haufig aus der exotischen Bohne. Aber sind Lebensmittel aus Soja wirklich der Weg zu einer umweltfreundlichen Ernahrung? Und wie wird aus einfachen Bohnen Geschnetzeltes, Hackfleisch und Wurst? Nelson Muller zeigt, warum...

programme.title: Meryn on Monday / MERYN am Montag
programme.desc: More and more children and adolescents in Austria are diagnosed with ADHD - attention deficit and hyperactivity. Affected people suffer from difficulty concentration, inner restlessness and impulsive behavior. But is it an actual increase or are the symptoms simply recognized today? Adults are also affected, often without knowing it. ADHD can heavily burden everyday life, school and professional life - but at the same time there are effective therapies and supporting. Does ADHD actually become a common disease in Austria? When is a behavior striking? How is ADHD diagnosed? And above all how can those affected and families be accompanied best? Siegfried Meryn answers her questions together with an expert on the topic in Meryn on Monday. Send us your questions or experience by email to medical@orf.at or via WhatsApp at +43/1/87878-25614. / Immer mehr Kinder und Jugendliche in Österreich erhalten die Diagnose ADHS - Aufmerksamkeitsdefizit- und Hyperaktivitatsstorung. Betroffene leiden unter Konzentrationsschwierigkeiten, innerer Unruhe und impulsivem Verhalten. Aber handelt es sich um eine tatsachliche Zunahme oder werden die Symptome heute einfach haufiger erkannt? Auch Erwachsene sind betroffen, oft ohne es zu wissen. ADHS kann den Alltag, die Schule und das Berufsleben stark belasten - zugleich gibt es aber wirksame Therapien und Unterstutzungsmoglichkeiten. Wird ADHS in Österreich tatsachlich zur Volkskrankheit? Ab wann ist ein Verhalten auffallig? Wie wird ADHS diagnostiziert? Und vor allem wie konnen Betroffene und Familien bestmoglich begleitet werden? Siegfried Meryn beantwortet Ihre Fragen zusammen mit einer oder einem ExpertIn zum Thema in MERYN am Montag. programme.title: Not falling silent - carelessness in the Nazi regime / Nicht verstummt - Gehorlose im NS-Regime
programme.desc: Coreless people primarily define themselves worldwide over the numerous structural languages. In Austria, language minority has been constitutionally recognized since September 1, 2005. During the time of National Socialism, however, they were persecuted by the regime at the time. In "not silent" for the first time, more obvious contemporary witnesses in Austrian and American building language tell their stories. They are based on what the Nazi rule caused in their community, report on threats, persecution and survival. With their visual language, they create a new picture of history - and themselves - and show that they were not silent. / Gehorlose Menschen definieren sich weltweit vorrangig uber die zahlreichen Gebardensprachen. In Österreich ist die Sprachminderheit seit dem 1. September 2005 verfassungsmaSSig anerkannt. Wahrend der Zeit des Nationalsozialismus wurden sie allerdings vom damaligen Regime verfolgt. In "Nicht verstummt" erzahlen erstmals gehorlose ZeitzeugInnen in Österreichischer und Amerikanischer Gebardensprache ihre Geschichten. Sie gebarden daruber, was die NS-Herrschaft in ihrer Gemeinschaft anrichtete, berichten von Bedrohung, Verfolgung und Überleben. Mit ihrer visuellen Sprache kreieren sie ein neues Bild der Geschichte - und ihrer selbst - und zeigen, dass sie nicht zum Verstummen gebracht wurden.

programme.title: The Villgratental in East Tyrol / Das Villgratental in Osttirol
programme.desc: E18 "Come to us, we have nothing!" - A mountain fan in the Villgratental once said to a travel journalist out of fun - and now this saying has become a fluggelical word. In the quiet side arm of the Puster Valley there are no monstrous bed castles, shopping centers, amusement parks and not even lifts - only pure nature. Surrounded by meadows, pastures, forest and mountains, you can quarter yourself in small inns, holiday apartments and alpine huts and let your mind wander. The Villgrat Valley in East Tyrol is a paradise for vacationers who want to avoid mass and event tourism. But the idyll is threatened. The voices, which overflowed for a stronger tourist development, are getting louder: If you don't invest your vigorously soon, you say, the remote valley will lose the connection completely. / E18 "Kommen Sie zu uns, wir haben nichts!" - hat ein Bergfuhrer im Villgratental einmal aus SpaSS zu einem Reisejournalisten gesagt - und mittlerweile ist dieser Spruch zum geflugelten Wort geworden. In dem stillen Seitenarm des Pustertals gibt es keine monstrosen Bettenburgen, Einkaufszentren, Freizeitparks und nicht einmal Lifte - nur Natur pur. Umgeben von Wiesen, Weiden, Waldern und Bergen kann man sich in kleinen Gasthofen, Ferienwohnungen und Almhutten einquartieren und ungestort die Seele baumeln lassen. Das Villgratental in Osttirol ist ein Paradies fur Urlauber, die dem Massen- und Event-Tourismus entgehen wollen. Doch die Idylle ist bedroht. Die Stimmen, die fur eine starkere touristische ErschlieSSung pladieren, werden immer lauter: wenn man nicht bald kraftig investiere, sagen sie, werde das abgelegene Tal den Anschluss vollig verlieren.

programme.title: Alpine paradise Hohe Tauern: Spatherbst / Alpenparadies Hohe Tauern: Spatherbst
programme.desc: The Hohe Tauern National Park is the greatest shelter in the Alps. It is a unique natural paradise and at the same time a traditional mountainous habitat. It goes into a beautiful and rough high mountain world, in which fauna and flora still develop undisturbed. In spectacular air recordings, unique views of an unpublished nature are obtained and there are fascinating and rare insights into the life of animal world - from the beard to the ibex. In addition, we visit villages, farmers and alpine pastures and drove the traditional mountain farmers in front of his eyes. (2017) / Der Nationalpark Hohe Tauern ist der groSSte Schutzraum der Alpen. Er ist ein einzigartiges Naturparadies und zugleich ein traditionsreicher bergbauerlicher Lebensraum. Es geht in eine ebenso schone wie raue Hochgebirgswelt, in der sich Fauna und Flora noch ungestort entfalten konnen. In spektakularen Flugaufnahmen erhalt man einzigartige Ausblicke in eine unberuhrte Natur und es gibt ebenso faszinierende wie seltene Einblicke in das Leben der Tierwelt - vom Bartgeier bis zum Steinbock. Daruber hinaus besuchen wir Dorfer, Bauernhofe und Almen und fuhren das traditionsreiche Bergbauern vor Augen. (2017)

programme.title: Vienna's erotic palace / Wiens erotische Palais
programme.desc: S01E03 The morality was high in Vienna of the Ringstrasse period, but the practice was completely different. While a prude society impresses every amorous misstep, the shoots led under the ceiling a second life. Finally, the Belvedere Castle is about the incredibly rich prince Eugen and his heiress, and about the curious course that this is going to take. R: Susanne Pleisnitzer / S01E03 Die Moral war hoch im Wien der RingstraSSenzeit, doch die Praxis eine ganz andere. Wahrend eine prude Gesellschaft jeden amourosen Fehltritt abstrafte, fuhrten die Triebe unter der Decke ein zweites Leben. Diese Schnitzlersche Doppelmoral wurde pragend fur diese Epoche und fand ihren Niederschlag in zahlreichen Affaren, die nicht zuletzt in den Wiener Prunkbauten abliefen. Das mondane Hotel Sacher war ein Treffpunkt der hoheren Gesellschaft - und was sich in den beliebten Separees so abspielte, konnte dem ausgezeichneten Ruf des Hauses nicht schaden. Einen Besuch in der Albertina nimmt Karl Hohenlohe zum Anlass, in ein Liebesdreieck von zwei hochstrangigen Habsburger Paaren einzutauchen - denn Kaisergattin Isabella war fur ihre Schwagerin Marie Christine entflammt. Im Schloss Belvedere geht es schlieSSlich unter anderem um den unfassbar reichen Prinzen Eugen und seine Erbin, und um den kuriosen Verlauf, den dieses Vermogen dann genommen hat. R: Susanne Pleisnitzer

programme.title: Einstein's Vienna / Einsteins Wien
programme.desc: Einstein and Vienna - In this interrelation, there is more than commonly known. Einstein was not only in Vienna and lived in an apartment in Grinzing, honorable as a house guest at the physicist Felix. In this production, the Esterreichische astrophysicist Franz Kerschbaum embarks on the footsteps of "Einstein's Vienna" and explains the proportion of Viennese research in the knowledge world of the American genius.
